Sources and measure definitions

  • IBO New York City Fiscal History: actual department expenditures in publisher $000s, shown here in USD; staffing is actual full-time positions reported as of June 30. Publisher vintage FY2022.
  • CityScroll registered-contract measures use the AP-03 population snapshot and mean registered contract value, not actual spending.
  • Actual payments use the separate AP-08 Checkbook Spending population and are shown only as the AP-09 payment fact.

These sources use different accounting and population scopes. Current snapshots have IBO fiscal years Unknown and procurement/payment years FY2025–FY2027; a blank measure is labeled Unknown because the publisher does not report a value for that year. No outsourcing or efficiency score is calculated.
